title: BNPL Diamond: How to Apply, Get Approved, and Start Using Your Plan
summary: This document explains BNPL Diamond eligibility and onboarding: you must be in segment HIGH_SPEND_RETAIL with average monthly spend ≥ $502500.00 (and for enterprise, annual revenue ≥ $50125000.00). It covers application steps, required documentation, accepting plan terms, default 12-month activation, and starting use by allocating eligible purchases and tracking installment due dates.
